title.narrative: Providing essential health services to host communities, returnees, refugees, and other people on the move at the Points of Entry of Metema (Amhara) and Kurmuk (Benishangul Gumuz).

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to respond to the surge in population in refugee-hosting areas that has overwhelmed healthcare facilities, leading to a scarcity of resources. This project will procure and distribute essential medical kits and drugs with an emphasis made on the delivery of malaria related kits and drugs, extend the deployment of Emergency Medical Teams (EMTs) at the Points of entry (PoEs) of Metema and Kurmuk to strengthen robust referral systems in the two PoEs and sensitize the population on outbreaks prevention with particular emphasis on malaria and cholera prevention. WHO’s project will benefit 20,018 individuals, including 4,853 men, 5,055 women, 5,055 boys and 5.055 girls, and including 3,523 persons with disabilities.
